notablePrerequisites: Tekuthal has at least one indestructible counter on it, and at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Tekuthal using Myojin of Towering Might's ability by removing an indestructible counter from it, putting six +1/+1 counters on Workhorse, and two +1/+1 counters on any creature you control.
Activate Workhorse three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Tekuthal by paying {3} and removing three +1/+1 counters from Workhorse, putting an indestructible counter on it.
Repeat.
